ideas.pitch: A verification gateway that serializes agent state, memory, and tool definitions into a portable JSON-LD schema, allowing an agent built in LangChain to instantly resume execution inside a Lyzr runtime without state loss.
ideas.title: CrossRuntime Agent Passport Validator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly addresses the core requirement of the Agent Passport Challenge by proving agent portability and interoperability across different runtimes.

ideas.pitch: A tool that automatically parses a BPMN workflow diagram and transpiles it into executable multi-agent configurations that can be deployed across different agent frameworks seamlessly.
ideas.title: BPMN Agent Runtime Migrator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven success of BPMN-orchestrated AI workflows while focusing on the framework migration and verification checkpoints required by the challenge.

ideas.pitch: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server extension that standardizes tool-calling schemas and context persistence so that autonomous agents can hot-swap their underlying LLM runtime mid-task.
ideas.title: Federated MCP Agent State Sync
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines federated protocol architectures with rigorous verification checkpoints, aligning with high-scoring engineering patterns from infrastructure hackathons.

ideas.pitch: An automated testing harness that subjects portable AI agents to adversarial inputs during runtime migration to prove that memory corruption and tool-hallucination do not occur when crossing ecosystems.
ideas.title: Adversarial State Verification Harness
ideas.why_it_could_win: Focuses heavily on production-grade documentation and verification checkpoints, which earn direct points in the 21-day challenge milestones.

ideas.pitch: A cryptographic verification pipeline that generates zero-knowledge proofs of agent execution steps, allowing a client to verify that a portable agent completed its task correctly on an untrusted runtime.
ideas.title: Zero-Knowledge Agent Proof Passport
ideas.why_it_could_win: Provides genuinely hard engineering that satisfies the verification and proof requirements of the Agent Passport Challenge.
